title: CombineResponse
description: The combined head: the slices that passed their own proof merged in plan order onto the wave's base, or where a merge did not apply, or that nothing was joined; and what proof is to be asked on it.

joined.description: combined, with the head, its branch and the slices merged; conflict, with the slice whose merge did not apply, those merged before it and the sentence; or nothing to join.

proving.description: What proof is to be asked for the checks: not asked, or a request, the slices whose kept tests filter the answer, and the solo proofs to run when the checks fail.

keptOf.description: The slices whose kept tests the answer is filtered against.

whenFailed.description: The solo proofs to run when the checks fail, one for each slice in the combined head.

stayed.description: A branch forge asked to drop and worktrees kept, with the reason it gave; left out when every drop went through.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.

dropped.description: The combined branch an earlier run left, dropped before the cut since the owner chose build-over, with its commit so its work can be found again; left out when there was none.

commit.description: The commit it pointed at, in full.
